findings.title: Tax is rounded independently, causing incorrect totals for small subtotals
findings.evidence: The implementation quantizes the tax amount before adding it back to the subtotal, so values like subtotal 0.05 with tax_rate 0.10 produce tax 0.01 and total 0.06 instead of rounding the final 0.055 to 0.06 only once. This changes monetary results in reachable normal inputs.
findings.recommendation: Compute the final total first and round once, for example by returning '(subtotal * (Decimal('1') + Decimal(str(tax_rate)))).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)', or document and test that per-line tax rounding is the intended contract.
